findings.problem: The example uses words not met before this card: mi, amor, mucho. In the frequency phase it may use at most two words not met yet.

back.es: I love you (affectionate, everyday; also used to mean 'I care about you' with family and friends).
back.example: I love you a lot, my love.

note: The hint is needed and correctly rules out te amo; the example translation's "so much" is fine, though "a lot" or "very much" is closer to mucho, since "so much" would be tanto.
